family.description: This entry represents the C-terminal region of approximately 1000 residues found in retroelement silencing factor 1 (RESF1) proteins in vertebrates. The full-length RESF1 protein interacts with the histone methyltransferase SETDB1 and is required for the recruitment of SETDB1 to endogenous retroviruses (ERVs), contributing to ERV silencing in embryonic stem cells [[cite:PUB00092441]]. The specific function of this C-terminal region remains to be determined.
family.name: Retroelement silencing factor 1 C-terminal region
